## Purpose
File uploads: images for vision input (the older path), attachments of any supported kind for chat messages and workflow inputs, and a report of how each file kind will be sent to a chosen model.

## Responsibilities
- **`POST /uploads/image`** (multipart `file`):
  - accepts only `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp` and `image/gif`; anything else gets 400 "Invalid file type: … Allowed: …";
  - rejects a file larger than `UPLOAD_MAX_MB` (400 "File too large. Max size: NMB") or empty (400 "Empty file uploaded");
  - saves it to `backend/uploads/<YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS>_<8 hex><ext>`;
  - returns `{filename, content_type, size_bytes, image_base64, image_url: "/uploads/<name>", image_mime}`.
- **`POST /uploads/file`**:
  - calls `attachments.save(filename, content, content_type, max_mb=UPLOAD_MAX_MB)`; an `AttachmentError` becomes 400;
  - returns the saved reference `{upload_id, filename, kind, mime, size, url, ...}`;
  - for images it also adds `image_url` and `image_mime` for older clients.
- **`GET /uploads/support?model=&agent_id=&api=chat`**:
  - with `agent_id`, it looks up the agent's own model (`agent_call.profile`) and switches `api` to `conversations`;
  - returns `{model, api, kinds: attachments.describe_support(model, api)}`, where each kind is `native` (sent as is) or `text` (converted).

## Key elements
- `UPLOAD_DIR` is `backend/uploads` and is created when the module is imported.
- `ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES` holds the four image types above.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
- Writes files into `backend/uploads`.
- `main.py` mounts that folder at `/uploads`, behind authentication (see the auth middleware).

## Configuration
`UPLOAD_MAX_MB` (default 20).

## Interactions
- Route policy: chat.use or orchestrator.use.
- `services/attachments.py` converts attachments for each model when a message is sent.
- Used by the Playground, agent chat and workflow file inputs.

## Error handling and edge cases
See Responsibilities.

## Nuances and gotchas
Agent chat runs on Mistral's Conversations API, which converts audio itself. That is why `api` changes when an `agent_id` is given.

## How to rebuild this file
Three handlers as described.
